description: This file provides a helper class 'SchemaHelper' for managing and modifying database schemas using Doctrine DBAL. It includes methods for adding, dropping, changing columns, managing foreign keys, creating tables, and toggling constraints. It is part of the OrangeHRM installer utilities, specifically version 1.

classes.name: SchemaHelper
classes.description: A utility class to facilitate schema modifications such as adding, dropping, renaming columns, managing foreign keys, creating tables, and enabling/disabling constraints within a database using Doctrine DBAL.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SchemaHelper with a Doctrine DBAL Connection object.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the stored database connection.

methods.name: dropColumn
methods.description: Drops a specific column from a table.

methods.name: dropColumns
methods.description: Drops multiple columns from a table.

methods.name: getTableColumn
methods.description: Retrieves a specific column object from a table.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager object.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a new column to a table with specified type and options.

methods.name: addOrChangeColumns
methods.description: Adds new columns or modifies existing columns based on provided options.

methods.name: changeColumn
methods.description: Modifies an existing column's options.

methods.name: renameColumn
methods.description: Renames a column in a table.

methods.name: dropForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops specified foreign keys from a table.

methods.name: addForeignKey
methods.description: Adds a foreign key constraint to a table.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a new Table object with charset, collation, and engine options.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the database.

methods.name: dropPrimaryKey
methods.description: Drops the primary key from a table.

methods.name: getNativeConnection
methods.description: Returns the native PDO connection object.

methods.name: disableConstraints
methods.description: Disables foreign key constraints in the database.

methods.name: enableConstraints
methods.description: Enables foreign key constraints in the database.

methods.name: columnExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific column exists in a table.

methods.name: dropIndex
methods.description: Drops an index from a table.
